required_external.name: CPython
required_external.recovery: An existing compatible CPython installation with stdlib venv/ensurepip. No network dependency is needed for package installation.

required_external.name: Windows native runtime libraries
required_external.recovery: The OS/compiler runtime dependencies required by the official unchanged extension. Tested only on the recorded machine, not promised on unsupported OS/ABI.

required_external.name: ASCII native temporary directory
required_external.recovery: Official4.5 persistence requires ASCII native temporary paths. Worker creates an exclusive directory under the accessible system TEMP/TMP, verifies ASCII, records the path and allows exactly that generated directory in its Python file-audit hook. Unicode final output paths are retained.

optional_external.name: NumPy
optional_external.scope: Only original direct-array CORE06/CORE07 transition ports, not the32default families or DEE thinking itself
optional_external.recovery: Install NumPy2.2.6 normally in a compatible CPython3.13x64 environment and pass its site-packages explicitly via --numpy-root. The worker verifies version/path and records source hashes; no historical scientific folders or download are used in the test. No installed package is copied into this ZIP.

preserved_not_offered_scripts: Historical inert source variants can mention older engines, scientific tools or private paths. Presence of those sources does not establish that they run under this package; the matrix and clean recovery whitelist define the operational scope.
